title: GitHub Copilot weekly releases — September 21

blocks.text: This week’s releases add new models to Copilot, local sandboxing in the Copilot app, and updates to Copilot in Slack, Microsoft Teams, JetBrains, and VS Code.
blocks.markdown: This week’s releases add new models to Copilot, local sandboxing in the Copilot app, and updates to Copilot in Slack, Microsoft Teams, JetBrains, and VS Code.

blocks.text: GitHub Copilot
blocks.markdown: GitHub Copilot

blocks.text: Claude Opus 5.5 is available to Copilot Pro+, Max, Business, and Enterprise plans.
blocks.markdown: Claude Opus 5.5 is available to Copilot Pro+, Max, Business, and Enterprise plans.

blocks.text: GPT-6 Sol is available to Copilot Pro+, Max, Business, and Enterprise plans.
blocks.markdown: GPT-6 Sol is available to Copilot Pro+, Max, Business, and Enterprise plans.

blocks.text: GPT-6 Luna is available to Copilot Pro, Pro+, Max, Business, and Enterprise plans.
blocks.markdown: GPT-6 Luna is available to Copilot Pro, Pro+, Max, Business, and Enterprise plans.

blocks.text: Grok 4.7 is available to Copilot Pro, Pro+, Max, Business, and Enterprise plans.
blocks.markdown: Grok 4.7 is available to Copilot Pro, Pro+, Max, Business, and Enterprise plans.

blocks.text: GitHub Copilot app
blocks.markdown: GitHub Copilot app

blocks.text: Limit agents’ access to files, networks, and credentials with local sandboxing, now in public preview.
blocks.markdown: Limit agents’ access to files, networks, and credentials with local sandboxing, now in public preview.

blocks.text: Track agent activity in your existing monitoring tools with OpenTelemetry, configured through enterprise-managed settings.
blocks.markdown: Track agent activity in your existing monitoring tools with OpenTelemetry, configured through enterprise-managed settings.

blocks.text: Download the Copilot app .
blocks.markdown: Download [the Copilot app](https://github.com/features/ai/github-app?utm_source=download-app-09-07&utm_medium=changelog&utm_campaign=weekly-copilot-launches-aug-2026).

blocks.text: GitHub Copilot in Slack and Microsoft Teams
blocks.markdown: GitHub Copilot in Slack and Microsoft Teams

blocks.text: Choose the best model for each task. Switch models mid-conversation, and Copilot keeps your choice for the rest of the thread. In Slack, you can also set channel defaults.
blocks.markdown: Choose the best model for each task. Switch models mid-conversation, and Copilot keeps your choice for the rest of the thread. In Slack, you can also set channel defaults.

blocks.text: Avoid duplicate issues since Copilot now checks for similar existing issues before creating a new one.
blocks.markdown: Avoid duplicate issues since Copilot now checks for similar existing issues before creating a new one.

blocks.text: Follow longer-running tasks more easily with clearer implementation-plan status, better recovery from interrupted or stale replies, and more predictable reconnection when a conversation goes idle.
blocks.markdown: Follow longer-running tasks more easily with clearer implementation-plan status, better recovery from interrupted or stale replies, and more predictable reconnection when a conversation goes idle.

blocks.text: Give Copilot more context in Slack by sharing supported files, attachments, and message links.
blocks.markdown: Give Copilot more context in Slack by sharing supported files, attachments, and message links.

blocks.text: Learn more about GitHub Copilot public previews in Slack and Teams .
blocks.markdown: Learn more about GitHub Copilot public previews in [Slack](https://docs.github.com/copilot/how-tos/copilot-integrations/integrate-cloud-agent-with-slack) and [Teams](https://docs.github.com/copilot/how-tos/copilot-integrations/integrate-cloud-agent-with-teams).

blocks.text: GitHub Copilot in JetBrains
blocks.markdown: GitHub Copilot in JetBrains

blocks.text: Assisted approvals, now in public preview for Copilot agent sessions, automatically approve low-risk tool calls while prompting you for higher-risk actions.
blocks.markdown: Assisted approvals, now in public preview for Copilot agent sessions, automatically approve low-risk tool calls while prompting you for higher-risk actions.

blocks.text: Edit an earlier message to redirect an agent session and Copilot rewinds both the conversation and file changes before sending the replacement request.
blocks.markdown: Edit an earlier message to redirect an agent session and Copilot rewinds both the conversation and file changes before sending the replacement request.

blocks.text: Shared organization and enterprise skills, along with organization-managed custom instructions, now work in local and Copilot agent sessions.
blocks.markdown: Shared organization and enterprise skills, along with organization-managed custom instructions, now work in local and Copilot agent sessions.

blocks.text: Learn more in the full Copilot in JetBrains changelog .
blocks.markdown: Learn more in the [full Copilot in JetBrains changelog](https://github.blog/changelog/2026-09-22-new-features-and-improvements-in-copilot-for-jetbrains/).

blocks.text: GitHub Copilot in VS Code 1.139 release
blocks.markdown: GitHub Copilot in VS Code 1.139 release

blocks.text: Run agents in Dev Containers on SSH, Tunnel, and WSL hosts, using your remote project’s tools and dependencies. Support is rolling out gradually.
blocks.markdown: Run agents in Dev Containers on SSH, Tunnel, and WSL hosts, using your remote project’s tools and dependencies. Support is rolling out gradually.

blocks.text: Keep busy session lists organized with Compact View, filters to hide empty groups, and the ability to rename sessions and chats directly in the list.
blocks.markdown: Keep busy session lists organized with Compact View, filters to hide empty groups, and the ability to rename sessions and chats directly in the list.

blocks.text: Choose between separate chat tabs or a single active-chat view within a session, without losing your conversations. This layout option is now in preview.
blocks.markdown: Choose between separate chat tabs or a single active-chat view within a session, without losing your conversations. This layout option is now in preview.

blocks.text: Explore everything that’s new in the full release notes .
blocks.markdown: Explore everything that’s new in the [full release notes](https://code.visualstudio.com/updates/v1_139).
